title: Dedicated autoscaler: SLO-aware burst controls, smoothing, and utilization reporting
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: customers running Dedicated fleets reported tail latency spikes during short traffic bursts and poor visibility into burst consumption vs. steady throughput. This PR implements SLO-aware burst controls, token-bucket smoothing with configurable decay, and enhanced utilization reporting to help SREs and platform teams understand and tune committed capacity.

What I changed (high level):
- Add a new BurstController that enforces per-fleet and per-priority burst budgets derived from committed throughput and SLOs.
- Implement token-bucket smoothing on top of the existing autoscaler token model to avoid step-changes when load drops. Smoothing parameters are policy-configurable and default to conservative decay.
- Emit new metrics and labels: dedicated.fleet.burst_used, dedicated.fleet.burst_available, dedicated.fleet.smoothing_rate, dedicated.fleet.utilization_by_priority. Metrics are stamped with fleet_id, region, and priority.
- Console: add per-fleet burst consumption chart and SLO-overview panel (UI wiring only; separate follow-up adds UX polish).
- Backwards-compatible config: existing autoscaler policies keep current behavior unless the new "enable_burst_controls" flag is enabled.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4567)
- [x] Unit and integration tests added
- [x] Metrics emitted and validated in staging
- [x] Console panel wired (feature flagged)

Risk and rollout plan:
- Feature gated behind fleet policy flag. Start with canary on low-risk fleets for 48h, monitor new metrics and latency SLOs, then ramp. Fallback path: disable flag to restore prior autoscaler behavior.

Notes:
- This PR focuses on controls and reporting; future PRs will add autoscaler-driven recommendations to Redwood Optimize using these metrics.

Related: ENG-4567, ENG-4599, previous work: pr-21437, pr-32148 for utilization reporting iterations.

release_notes: Improved Dedicated autoscaler with SLO-aware burst controls, token-bucket smoothing to reduce post-burst spikes, and enhanced utilization metrics for per-fleet and per-priority visibility. Feature is behind a policy flag; see docs/autoscaler/burst-controls.md for configuration and rollout guidance.
notes_for_oncall: If customers report sudden capacity shortages after enabling burst controls, check dedicated.fleet.burst_used and dedicated.fleet.burst_available; disable feature flag for the affected fleet to restore previous behavior. Observe tokenbucket smoothing_rate to tune decay parameter.
testing_instructions: Unit and integration tests included. To validate manually: enable enable_burst_controls in helm values, deploy to staging, run integration-tests/autoscaler/burst_smoke_test.py, and check new metrics via metrics/alerting dashboards.
